title: Tech Note: Building Applications Examples – Part 2 General Parameters and Licenses
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Another installment in the well-regarded mid-2000s XML-keys tutorial series; the specific General Parameters/Licenses XML key format documented here reflects 4D 2004's build-configuration model, since substantially reworked in later 4D versions and especially by the Project Mode (2018) shift to a git-friendly, fully text-based project structure.
related_updates: 4D's build/compile configuration format has changed considerably since the 4D 2004 era described here
Project Mode (2018+) changed how build settings, including general parameters and license configuration, are stored and edited
